subject: Request: official English text of the Fatima prayers for a free Catholic prayer app
body:
Dear Liturgy Department of the Shrine of Fátima,

North Boutique Studios Ltd. publishes John 1:1, a free Catholic Bible and prayer app for iPhone, iPad and
Android. We want every prayer in the app to come from an approved source. We would like to include, in their
official English form:

- the prayer said after each decade of the Rosary ("O my Jesus, forgive us our sins…");
- the prayers taught by the Angel ("My God, I believe, I adore, I hope and I love Thee…" and "Most Holy
  Trinity…").

We ask which English text the Shrine uses or approves, and for permission to include it, unchanged, with the
Shrine's credit line and a link to fatima.pt.

- Use: in the app's Rosary guide and prayer library, available offline, free. The app has no ads and no
  account. One optional purchase unlocks a library of Church Fathers; the prayers are not part of it.
- Platforms and markets: iOS and Android, worldwide, English.
- Audience: about 120 new downloads every 90 days and about 330 existing users (October 2026).
- Organisation: North Boutique Studios Ltd., 846 Roulston St, London, ON N6H 0E4, Canada.
